title: Usage-linked observability credit model & contract questionnaire pilot
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Pilot an alternative add-on model for observability that charges for retention as a pool of credits tied to customer usage patterns, and integrate results with the enterprise contract/security questionnaire flow. Goal: provide a PLG-friendly tier that reduces friction for mid-market customers while preserving revenue for enterprise by letting security questionnaire answers unlock or restrict credit-based retention add-ons and premium SLA options. The experiment covers billing model schema, Console entitlements UI, contract language snippets, and telemetry to measure substitution vs. net-new add-on purchases.
acceptance_criteria: Billing: implement a credit bucket schema (monthly allotment + overage) that maps to retention windows (7d/30d/90d) in the billing engine mock and returns cost estimates in the pricing preview API
Entitlements: Console shows a new "credits retention" toggle and dropdown; security questionnaire responses map to enable/disable default credit allowances during contract signature
Contract: legal-approved clause templates for credit-based observability and premium SLA annex available as snippets for AE insertion
Telemetry: dashboard that reports credit consumption, retention tier changes, renewal impact, and % of customers converting from baseline to credits within 30 days
Experiment: A/B assignment for eligible customers with success metrics defined (conversion to paid add-on, MRR delta, change in support cases), and experiment guardrails for revenue protection

rollout_notes: Phase 0 (internal): feature behind a console flag; biller in 'preview' mode; QA run against test tenants
Phase 1 (pilot): enable for selected 12 customers via AE invites; include contract annex; collect conversion and usage telemetry
Phase 2 (scale): open to self-serve with a guided pricing preview if pilot metrics meet thresholds (MRR uplift > 5% and < 2% increase in support cases)
Rollback: ability to convert credit buckets to flat-retention add-on and prorate credits on next invoice
